	CreditSales,

	CreditSR,

	CreditService,
	CashServiceReturn,
	CreditServiceReturn,
	TotalReceipts,
	TotalPayments,
	NetAmt,
	DiffAmt,

	CashierShift

	CashierShiftCode=:ai_code
